formalDefinition: Given an input string S over some alphabet, find a binary encoding of S that uses a prefix-free code so that S can be decoded exactly back into the original string.
problemDefinition: Lossless Data Compression is the problem of reducing the size of data while still allowing the original data to be perfectly reconstructed. For this Redux contribution, the selected algorithm is Huffman Encoding. Huffman Encoding builds a prefix-free binary code where characters that appear more often usually receive shorter codes, and characters that appear less often usually receive longer codes.
inputDescription: S, a raw text string to compress
outputDescription: A prefix-free Huffman code table for S together with S encoded using it
source: David A. Huffman, A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes, Proceedings of the IRE, 1952.
defaultInstance: this is an example of lossless data compression using huffman encoding
instanceFormat: Format: S | any raw text string to compress Example: this is an example of lossless data compression using huffman encoding
certificateFormat: Format: ({(asciiCode1,code1),(asciiCode2,code2),...},bitstring) | prefix-free code table paired with S encoded using it; () if S is empty Example: ({(97,0),(98,10),(99,11)},01011)
